# IAggregationRouterV6
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/1inch/IAggregationRouterV6.sol)

**Title:**
IAggregationRouterV6

Minimal interface for the 1inch AggregationRouterV6 swap entry point


## Functions
### swap

Performs a token swap using the provided executor and swap description


```solidity
function swap(
    address executor,
    SwapDescription calldata desc,
    bytes calldata permit,
    bytes calldata data
)
    external
    payable
    returns (uint256 returnAmount, uint256 spentAmount);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`executor`|`address`|The address of the executor contract that performs the swap|
|`desc`|`SwapDescription`|The swap description parameters|
|`permit`|`bytes`|Optional permit data used to approve the source token|
|`data`|`bytes`|Encoded calldata forwarded to the executor|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`returnAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of destination token received|
|`spentAmount`|`uint256`|The amount of source token actually spent|


## Structs
### SwapDescription
Parameters describing a swap to be executed by the router


```solidity
struct SwapDescription {
    IERC20 srcToken;
    IERC20 dstToken;
    address payable srcReceiver;
    address payable dstReceiver;
    uint256 amount;
    uint256 minReturnAmount;
    uint256 flags;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`srcToken`|`IERC20`|The token being sold|
|`dstToken`|`IERC20`|The token being bought|
|`srcReceiver`|`address payable`|The address that receives the source tokens (the executor)|
|`dstReceiver`|`address payable`|The address that receives the destination tokens|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of source token to swap|
|`minReturnAmount`|`uint256`|The minimum acceptable amount of destination token|
|`flags`|`uint256`|Bit flags controlling swap behavior|
